en: The image is the back of a postcard or photographic card, with printed and handwritten text describing a photograph of Helena Forti, a soprano singer, in Dresden, 1915. The text notes this as a full-portrait photograph, possibly with autograph, and includes cataloging and archival details from the Deutsche Fotothek in Dresden. There are boxes at the bottom for classification with handwritten words and numbers.
